_comment: Frozen BO7 inference baseline. Pretrained FASHN VTON v1.5 only. These are the values used in the Phase 3/3b/4A experiments (seed/guidance/segmentation_free = FASHN repo defaults).

preview.note: development/default preview; 20-step C results looked indistinguishable from 30 on 4 comparisons (1 person) - see MODEL_CARD

garment_photo_type_note: Must be set per garment image: 'model' (worn) or 'flat-lay'. 'model' was used for all Myntra experiments.

person_input.note: tight_crop_3x4 is the leading experimental candidate, NOT a proven winner (1 person, visual, seed-dependent)

human_parser.note: Upstream loads it from the HF hub by name with no revision pin; this package pins a revision and loads it from a local directory.
